generators.carrier: ledger row record (claim identifier with ceiling, assumptions, replay status)

relations.statement: For every bound row r, ceiling(r), assumptions(r), and replay_status(r) equal the values stored in the ledger for the cited identifier; projecting a row to its title alone is not a valid binding.
relations.hypotheses: Ledger entry exists for the identifier; ceiling is one of candidate_mirror, continuum_interface, source_claim, or another ledger-declared label.

relations.statement: A row labelled formal_finite_result must also carry a source locus, a hash, assumptions, and replay status.
The author-supplied status string in the certifier catalog does not change authority_effect, which stays None.
relations.hypotheses: Record is in the certifier catalog.

lemmas.statement: The runtime citation map sends each claim identifier to a row that carries the ledger ceiling, assumptions, and replay status unchanged.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem copy_triple_with_id (cite : Id -> Row) (ledger : Id -> Row) (h : cite = ledger) (i : Id) : (cite i).ceiling = (ledger i).ceiling := by sorry

lemmas.statement: A binding that keeps only the title is not a valid binding whenever two ledger rows share a title but differ in ceiling.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem title_only_fails (r1 r2 : Row) (ht : r1.title = r2.title) (hc : r1.ceiling ≠ r2.ceiling) : ¬ (r1 = r2) := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Citing QM-000 by title alone is a valid binding.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The ceiling candidate_mirror would be lost, so the row could be read as stronger than it is.

near_misses.claim: The label formal_finite_result alone suffices to cite a row.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The row must still name a source locus, a hash, assumptions, and replay status.

near_misses.claim: An author-supplied status string in the catalog sets authority_effect.

open_obligations: No ledger-row, catalog, or runtime-binding declaration was listed under @SRC, so all of those entries are proposed_new.
The only existing citation is authority_effect in code/python/src/mub/__init__.py, which returns the constant None; it does not model the ledger itself.
Lean types Id and Row are not defined, so the skeletons are untested.
Source locus and hash fields for QM-000, QM-020-UNIQ, and the source_claim rows are not grounded.
